limits: Native startup traces clip SQL200chars, retain values only below4096 JSONchars and record finally durations without result rows/rejection outcome/JS callsite. Finite durations do not prove native-call success.
One-trial report verdicts are not full acceptance or retention clearance. Both goals and mean/heap guards remain open.

Guard trace and standard report raw formats do not independently contain boot/actual installed hash; those are bound through runner manifest, actual installed checks, scoped reboot stdout and per-file SHA.
The original 300-second untimed guard waits and 60-second scoped cold-boot settles remain unchanged. Source/tool/APK provenance is checked before any comparison.

All eleven point metrics and both-order adverse deltas are retained. Sample SD is independently recomputed for guard and raw toggle/emission arrays; there is only one observation per leg for the other point metrics.
Both emulators share host resources. Historical comparisons across device environments are confounded; no causal CPU, SQL CPU, floor, heap or general performance claim is established.
No extra CPU/heap/PSS/GC captures are created by this offline verifier; standard approved report memory measurements remain unchanged.
